items.html: And now the Nefesh of man was from the Nukva of ZA, which descended to the place of the Nefesh in Beriah; and his Ruach was from ZA, which descended to the place of his Nukva. And with this will be justified the saying that states that Nefesh and Ruach are Malchut and Tifferet; and it will not contradict the saying of the Saba, which speaks after the sin of man.
